aggtrade_integrity.aggregate_and_underlying_id_gaps: REJECT; counters preserved; no inferred missing trades
aggtrade_integrity.buyer_is_maker: exact boolean m, preserved without sign reversal
aggtrade_integrity.duplicates: consecutive identical full payloads retained raw and skipped in derived contexts
aggtrade_integrity.numbers: strict integer IDs/timestamps; exact decimal text, finite positive price/quantity
aggtrade_integrity.required: at least one accepted unique aggTrade

causality.clock_skew: future exchange timestamps fail integrity; no clock correction inferred
causality.context: latest valid reconstructed L2 with availability <= trade receive timestamp
causality.missing_context: remains missing; counted and allowed; never repaired by future data
causality.snapshot_bridge_availability: buffered diff effects become available no earlier than snapshot receipt
causality.timestamps: UTC-aware; nonregressing receive time per source; raw receipt within closed session; exchange event <= receive

depth_integrity.raw_validation: strict integer update IDs; exact finite decimal text; positive prices, nonnegative depth quantities; duplicate depth prices REJECT
depth_integrity.required: at least one snapshot and reconstructed update; final book valid
depth_integrity.resolved_gaps: also REJECT in V1; no recovery exception
depth_integrity.resync_boundaries: preserved RESYNC_BOUNDARY records; count must match live/replay; replacement snapshot requires a preceding boundary
depth_integrity.synchronization: existing V9 snapshot/diff U/u bridging and reconstruction

evidence_policy.independent_confirmatory_strategy_eviden: FORBIDDEN unless the strategy hypothesis was frozen before session generation and its eligibility rules pass
evidence_policy.later_discovery: permitted only under a separately authorized research task

readiness.hours: sum min(requested duration, closed end minus start) for unique non-overlapping eligible sessions
readiness.meaning: data sufficiency only, not a trading hypothesis or profitability evidence

definition.reconnect_policy: REJECT any reconnect in either stream: collector V1 has counters but incomplete raw reconnect boundary provenance
definition.replay: two independent raw replays must exactly match sealed replay metadata and live counters; hash every causal context during readiness

session.artifact_verification: exact identity, raw sizes/counts/SHA256, manifest SHA256, closure SHA256 binding; rehash after scan
session.duplicates: byte-identical artifact sets count once; conflicting copies invalidate every copy of that session ID
session.duration_seconds: positive integer <= 86400, declared immutably per session
session.identity: shared immutable ID equal to UTC start formatted YYYYmmddTHHMMSSffffffZ
session.interrupted: REJECT; requires a future separately frozen recovery protocol
session.max_levels_per_side: positive integer <= 5000, declared immutably per session
session.overlapping_sessions: reject every overlapping eligible session; touching endpoints allowed
session.raw_persistence: separate append-only logs, contiguous zero-based source record indices
session.source_identity: resolvable Git source commit with the frozen collector source hashes; local replay source must match
session.start_rule: session_start > prospective_cutoff; equality and straddling REJECT
